title: Mentaiko Tagliatelle
description: A creamy, intense pasta dish featuring roasted mentaiko and parmesan cheese.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the tagliatelle according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the roasted mentaiko to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and oil. Cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Add the cooked tagliatelle to the skillet and toss to combine with the mentaiko mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated parmesan cheese and chopped parsley.
